title: The Horsehead Nebula in Infrared
explanation: The Horsehead Nebula is one of the most identifiable nebulae in the sky. It appears as a dark indentation to a red emission nebula in visible light, but in infrared the dust is largely transparent and the structure resolves into something unrecognisable.
